articles.title: Christopher Kane and Mulberry make swaggering joint comeback at London fashion week
articles.summary: Appointment of Kane as creative director signals the return of serious style ambition for former It-bag brand. With spicy leather mini-dresses and shoes with miniature axes for heels, two beloved British names made a swaggering joint comeback at London fashion week.
body: Fifteen years ago, Christopher Kane and Mulberry were two of the biggest shows on the line-up. Kane was the brilliant young designer who could find fashion in the most unlikely places: rubberised lace minis were inspired by “Princess Margaret on acid”; while illustrations from the 1972 classic The Joy of Sex appeared on slinky slip dresses. Mulberry was London’s home-grown It-bag brand: anyone who was anyone had a Bayswater or an Alexa.

On paper, it is an unlikely match. Mulberry is rooted in its Somerset factories and makes understated practical bags; Kane has a flair for bad-girl party dresses learned on the streets of Glasgow where he grew up.

Where they meet is leather. There were leather sheath dresses and elegantly spare leather car coats, as well as heeled loafers featuring Mulberry’s signature postman’s lock. Kane builds each collection around one visual motif – Frankenstein, gorillas, the reproductive organs of plants – and for this collection, took the castellated leather flaps of Mulberry’s Bayswater bags and turned them into notched hems and necklines. This was punchy, full-throttle fashion, accessorised with money-making bags and shoes.
points: Appointment of Kane as creative director signals the return of serious style ambition for former It-bag brand.

articles.title: At The Nat Gala, Gabriela Hearst Celebrates Indigenous Matriarchs
articles.summary: The Nat works to close the nature finance gap, and will next host a special gala in Paris in April 2027, Hearst announced on Sunday.
body: On Sunday night, celebrities, financiers, industry leaders and climate activists gathered in New York for the second annual Nat Gala. It was a starry affair supporting a decidedly un-starry subject: closing the approximately $700 billion nature finance gap.

Among the honorees was Dee Jay Two Bears, a filmmaker, artist and activist from the Standing Rock Sioux Tribe, who was heavily involved in the Dakota Access Pipeline protests from 2016 to 2017. While introducing Two Bears, and marking the 10th anniversary of Standing Rock, fashion designer Gabriela Hearst announced that the Nat Gala will head to Paris for the first time in April 2027, for an additional special event focused on the role of Indigenous matriarchs in galvanizing climate action and spearheading nature conservation.

While the main New York gala benefits the Blue Marine Foundation, Conservation International and Open Planet, the Paris event will specifically open up funding to Indigenous-led organizations, to be decided in due course.

articles.title: Victoria Starmer models clothes at London fashion week show
articles.summary: Wife of former PM takes part in designer Edeline Lee’s show inspired by the Greek myth of Sisyphus. Victoria Starmer has taken part in a London fashion week show, in one of her first public appearances since her husband, Keir Starmer, stepped down as prime minister.
body: Lady Starmer appeared at Sunday’s Edeline Lee show. The London-based, Canadian British designer’s clothes are a favourite of the Princess of Wales, and have also been worn by celebrities including singer Taylor Swift and actor and screenwriter Phoebe Waller-Bridge.

Lee’s spring/summer 2027 show took place in the unusual setting of a north London school sports hall. Starmer wore a bright turquoise knitted midi dress with a high neckline, pleated detailing and short, sculptural sleeves, paired with white block-heeled shoes, with her hair worn in loose waves.

Rather than preparations for the show taking place backstage in the usual way, in Lee’s unique show, models were fitted and adjusted in full view of the audience, dancers rehearsed beside the catwalk, while a drone followed proceedings from the high ceiling of the gymnasium.

Starmer was photographed having her makeup done beside the catwalk, against a backdrop of a football net, with makeup and hair products spread out over a table in front of her. Ballerinas stretched beside the catwalk and synchronised swimming-inspired dancers performed in bright red costumes as part of the show, in the school in Chalk Farm.

articles.title: Hungry for connection? This is what we lose when we stop eating together | Shadi Khan Saif
articles.summary: Mealtimes offer a pause in the day for parents and children to sit together, listen to one another and trade stories. Making sense of it is a column about spirituality and how it can be used to navigate everyday life. When I was growing up in a Muslim household, food was rarely just food.
body: There was even a small ritual around something as ordinary as a piece of bread. If it fell on the ground anywhere in the house or was even seen on the ground outside, we would pick it up, clean it, kiss it respectfully and place it somewhere clean and safe. Food was not to be treated carelessly.
And sending a guest away without offering them a meal is unthinkable – almost a sin.
As a child, I didn’t think of any of this as “spirituality”. It was simply what you did. Eating alone felt like punishment. It still does.

Only later, after leaving Afghanistan and building a life in Australia, did I begin to understand what those ordinary habits carried with them: gratitude, hospitality and a sense that food was something to be celebrated – and shared.

articles.title: 37 Best Taco Recipes for More Than Just Tuesday
articles.summary: Crispy smashed pork, honey-chipotle shrimp, and more of our favorite tacos.
body: When in doubt, make tacos. The crowd-pleasing dinner can satisfy just about any craving. From carne asada and crispy pork carnitas to easy chicken tacos, flaky fish, and plenty of vegetarian options, these taco recipes cover quick weeknight dinners, easy breakfast options, and more ambitious weekend projects, too.

Some come together fast—like broiled shrimp tacos and skillet-cooked fish—while birria, carnitas, and al pastor reward a little more time. Most call for store-bought corn or flour tortillas, though you can always make your own corn tortillas. Add pico de gallo, guacamole, or refried beans if you’re feeling ambitious. However you fill them, the taco recipes below give you plenty of reasons to declare any night taco night.

articles.title: Vogue World: Milano: Everything You Need to Know About the 2026 Event
articles.summary: Vogue World’s goal in Milan? To celebrate Made in Italy, craftsmanship, and, above all, the human side of fashion. Here’s what you need to know ahead of the 2026 event.
body: After exuberant iterations in New York, London, Paris, and Los Angeles, it was only right that Vogue World journeyed to Italy—and this month, it’s doing just that.

Last November, Vogue Italia announced that the global fashion celebration would next take place in Milan, on the first day of Milan Fashion Week. Its overarching theme? Uplifting “craftsmanship and the human touch” in the age of technology.

“We are so excited that Milan will be the next city to host Vogue World in 2026,” Francesca Ragazzi, Vogue Italia’s head of editorial content, said in a statement. “This extraordinary event offers a unique opportunity to celebrate with a global audience the timeless story of Made in Italy, a story of genius and craftsmanship. It feels particularly meaningful to do so at this moment in time, in the era of artificial intelligence.”
Just a few months after its turn co-hosting the Winter Olympic Games, Milan will serve as the setting for Vogue World’s sweeping celebration of handicraft on Tuesday, September 22, 2026.

articles.title: How to Grow Your Hair Faster: 11 Foolproof Tips from the Pros
articles.summary: From the best hair care products to a hair health diet, sought-after pros weigh in on how to maximize your length to transformative effect.
body: Whether you’ve been missing your long hair after an impulsive bob cut or become a victim of a regrettable TikTok hair trend, wondering how to grow your hair faster is a universal question we’ve all experienced at least once in our lives. How to go about promoting healthy hair growth depends on your specific wants and needs, but one thing is certain: There is no quick fix.

“The day you decide to grow out your hair, you have to really start taking care of it,” says hairstylist Mark Townsend, insisting, “to get the length, there are sacrifices.” The reality is there’s no shortcut to an endless, luxurious mane—it’s a months-long, methodical process. One that can feel especially tedious if you’re contending with stress-induced hair shedding.

But don’t feel overwhelmed or defeated just yet. With a little bit of patience, the right products, hair-growth-focused ingredients, and some pivots to your everyday routines, you’ll be on the right track for growing out your hair. Here, Townsend and other sought-after pros weigh in on how to grow your hair faster and maximize your length.

articles.title: Hollywood’s Big Night Out: Inside the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art’s Star-Studded Grand Reveal
articles.summary: On Saturday night, ahead of its September 22 opening, the museum drew a star-studded crowd of Hollywood’s biggest names, from Harrison Ford and Steven Spielberg to Leonardo DiCaprio, Oprah Winfrey, Michael B. Jordan, Katy Perry, and Kim Kardashian.
body: Founded by filmmaker George Lucas and his wife, Mellody Hobson, the museum is not simply a monument to Star Wars, but a sweeping love letter to the art of storytelling, bringing together paintings, illustrations, photography, animation and cinematic imagery that explore how pictures have the power to shape the stories we tell.

Located in downtown Los Angeles, across from Lucas’s alma mater, the University of Southern California, the museum is a five-story, 300,000-square-foot building featuring 35 galleries and more than 40,000 works. The collection spans celebrated artists including Norman Rockwell, Frida Kahlo, and Banksy, as well as comic art by Jack Kirby. And yes, there are plenty of Star Wars artifacts. The museum’s inaugural exhibition, Star Wars in Motion, showcases vehicles, costumes—including Princess Leia’s—props, and artwork from the first six films. There’s also Luke Skywalker’s Landspeeder and the first physical build of General Grievous’s Wheel Bike from Revenge of the Sith.

articles.title: 31 Best Butternut Squash Recipes
articles.summary: Like maple-bacon chopped salad and canned butternut squash orzotto.
body: Butternut squash is a seasonal favorite for a reason. It’s subtly sweet, easy to find, and versatile enough for everything from soups and pastas to salads and breakfast muffins. Where pumpkin spice lattes signal the arrival of fall, butternut squash quietly defines fall cooking.

For the easiest preparation, roast cubed squash ( pre-prepped store-bought squash is fine!) until browned and tender; puréed squash—even canned—is especially good in soups and sauces. Its sweetness plays well with sage and brown butter, chile, coconut, hearty greens, and plenty of cheese. Below, find our favorite butternut squash recipes, from cozy orzo with fried sage to crispy phyllo pie and savory-sweet tarte Tatin.

The best is subjective, but roasting is certainly one of the easiest ways to cook butternut squash—and one of the best for bringing out its natural sweetness. For our go-to method, peel and seed the squash, cut it into 1½" pieces, and toss with olive oil, kosher salt, and black pepper. Roast at 450°F for 35–45 minutes, until browned, tender, and easily pierced with a fork. You can also roast butternut squash whole, simmer it for soup, or shred it for quicker cooking.
